name: Simvastatin
reviewed_by: William Gregory M. Rivero, MD, FPCP, DPSN
drafted_by: AI-assisted draft (Claude) for review by Dr. W. Rivero

key_interactions.drug_or_class: Strong CYP3A4 inhibitors (itraconazole, ketoconazole, posaconazole, voriconazole, erythromycin, clarithromycin, nelfinavir, ritonavir, darunavir/ritonavir, cobicistat, nefazodone)
key_interactions.effect: Much higher simvastatin exposure; myopathy and rhabdomyolysis (label).
key_interactions.action: Contraindicated. If the inhibitor is unavoidable, suspend simvastatin during that course.

key_interactions.effect: Higher risk of myopathy and rhabdomyolysis (label).

key_interactions.action: Do not exceed simvastatin 10 mg daily.
Do not exceed simvastatin 20 mg daily.
Reduce the simvastatin dose by 50%; do not exceed 20 mg daily.

key_interactions.drug_or_class: Niacin at lipid-modifying doses (1 g/day or more)
key_interactions.effect: Myopathy and rhabdomyolysis; greater risk in Chinese patients (label).
key_interactions.action: Not recommended in Chinese patients; otherwise weigh benefit and monitor for myopathy.
Avoid large amounts of grapefruit juice.
Check INR before starting and during dose changes.
